findings.title: The account reaches beneath visible and inherited scripts
findings.claim: The focus's covering/denial and chest knowledge meet 31:20's visible/inward blessings and dispute without knowledge, then 31:21's inherited following; on this attributed reading, the closing account reaches an inward source beneath public and inherited scripts, so visible speech is not treated as the whole deed.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies k-f-r, performed work, report, and chests. The earlier context gives benefits described as apparent and hidden, public dispute, and an appeal to what was found with the fathers; those separate context carriers return through the focus chest and account, changing the close from generic private awareness to an account that distinguishes inward source from performed or inherited script.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive inherited and public scripts as part of the setting in which actions are performed, while the account reaches the inward source that adopts, resists, or instrumentalizes them.
findings.containment: This remains an attributed inference from exact Arabic and HFT roles without target morphology. The ancestry passage may describe content without implying psychological layering; neither inheritance nor public speech excuses or proves a person's inward state.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace supplies exact 31:20, 31:21, and focus Arabic with matching coordinates; all context root-to-role assignments remain attributed because the external branches are unresolved.

findings.title: Covering as a bounded burial analogy
findings.claim: As a bounded analogy, the focus covering word meets 31:16's grain enclosed in rock or earth; because the focus then reports performed deeds, concealment can resemble burial that leaves an act poised to emerge into account.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies a covering carrier, intentional deed, and delivered report; 31:16 supplies a germ-bearing grain inside hard enclosure and says God brings it. Their contact allows the seed-covering branch to describe delayed emergence without turning the focus verb into a lexical name for a farmer.
findings.reader_payoff: A concealed act can be imagined as hidden rather than cancelled, with its later report still in view.
findings.containment: The focus's ordinary sense remains denial/disbelief. The farmer branch is an analogical contextual reading only, not the lexical translation of the finite verb; 31:16 may also illustrate divine power generally.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace supplies the focus/context contact, but its branch application is explicitly analogical and the source itself preserves an alternative.
